name: backdoor/update-role-trust
description: Append a trust policy statement to an existing IAM role via Batch job (requires CONTAINER_RUNTIME=generic with jq)

options.name: TARGET_ROLE
options.description: Name of the IAM role whose trust policy to modify

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: Principal to add to the trust policy (ARN or service like lambda.amazonaws.com)
